Strategy: Refine the family with a two-item peak: score bins by closeness of the leftover to twice the item size, with a bonus for an exact fit. The choice differs from Best Fit when the tightest bin leaves far less than two items while a looser bin leaves about two. Reserving two-item room may pair equal items, but it can waste tight fits when equal items never arrive.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [(10000 if r == item else 0) - abs((r - item) - 2 * item) for r in bins]
```
